focusedModelSuite.note: The isolated review worktree had no node_modules. Fast-check-dependent focused tests ran read-only in the clean implementation worktree after independently proving its head and tree exactly matched this review target. The review lane ran no install and changed no implementation or lockfile.

phase1Ci.resumptionAction: Coordinator owns the single serialized complete Phase 1 CI run at the unchanged frozen implementation head.

findings.evidence: The chat model stores a pending native action without invite/call generation and accepts via an unrelated command. invite does not clear or rebind a pending action. An expired generation-1 action followed by accept reaches accepted with expiredNativeActions=[action-1] and no violation; a retained generation-1 action can also be consumed after generation 2 starts and generation 2 becomes accepted with no violation.
findings.impact: The T2 chat-call result does not prove the required expired-action denial or prevent an old native Answer from authorizing a newer call. The separate notification model is not composed with invite, token, room, or cleanup state and cannot supply this missing end-to-end invariant.
findings.requiredResolution: Bind every native action to immutable call/invite identity and generation, model the native acceptance transition into the authoritative call state, deny expired or prior-generation actions, clear or terminalize pending action state on terminal transitions, and add both minimized sequences as fixed-model regressions.

findings.evidence: receive_push(mustReport=true) records an outstanding push, but violations only checks a must-report push after it appears in completedPushes. The fixed transition refuses complete_push before report, so the obligation may remain outstanding indefinitely with callKitReported=[], completedPushes=[], violations=[], and MODEL_CLEAR. The only notification transition witness covers native Answer/server acceptance, not PushKit report and completion.
findings.impact: The model proves that one forbidden completion is blocked but does not prove the required must-report path or fail a quiescent/terminal execution that never reports to CallKit.
findings.requiredResolution: Represent the must-report obligation explicitly, add a bounded terminal/quiescence evaluation command, require report before terminal completion, add a receive-report-complete witness, and retain the historical complete-without-report fixture.

findings.evidence: server_cancel and server_timeout only change serverStatus. They leave pendingActions live, and consume_action does not require serverStatus=ringing. Both native_answer -> terminal server transition -> auth_ready -> react_ready -> consume_action schedules consume the Answer after terminal state with violations=[]. The committed hostile test checks only that the terminal status string changed.
findings.impact: Cancel/timeout cleanup is not exact and a native action survives beyond the authoritative call lifetime. A later bridge/session boot can consume terminal work even though server_accept happens to reject it.
findings.requiredResolution: Atomically terminalize pending actions on cancel, timeout, decline, and end; forbid consumption outside ringing; add invariants for terminal/pending and terminal/new-consumption overlap; and add cancel and timeout historical/current regression sequences.

findings.evidence: The authority guard rejects only eventTime < maxAuthoritativeTime. A renewal and revocation at the same provider time produce active access or revoked access solely from arrival order, and both final states have no violation. The scenario named revenuecat-expiration-versus-delayed-renewal assigns expiration time 10 and renewal time 20, so both schedules correctly end active and never exercise a stale renewal delivered after a newer expiration.
findings.impact: Out-of-order authority is not deterministic at equal timestamps, and the reported 20 schedules do not include the required stale delayed-renewal interleaving. This can hide terminal entitlement reactivation.
findings.requiredResolution: Define a deterministic authoritative ordering key and equal-time policy, model terminal event precedence or an exact provider sequence, change the delayed-renewal schedule so the delayed delivery is older than the expiration, and assert the terminal state in both serialized orders.

findings.evidence: Only chat-call, notification-native-action, and livekit have transition witnesses. revenuecat, ota-build, and migrations each report transitionWitnesses=[] and still become MODEL_CLEAR because Array.every on an empty array is true. The test loops over whatever witnesses exist and never requires at least one witness or required-state coverage per domain.
findings.impact: A no-op or transition-suppressing implementation for half of the modeled domains can still satisfy the non-vacuity guard, so the former vacuous property-coverage P1 is only partially fixed.
findings.requiredResolution: Declare required states/transitions and positive/negative witnesses per domain, fail when any selected domain lacks its required witnesses, record reached-state coverage, and add a regression proving no-op RevenueCat, OTA, and migration models are BLOCKED_INTERNAL.

findings.evidence: The fixed transitions reject cross-platform evidence and clamp reconnect counts, but no historical variant or escaped-defect fixture can make LIVEKIT_DUPLICATE_ROOM_OR_TRACK or PLATFORM_SCOPE_MISMATCH fire. The 13-fixture report therefore does not demonstrate that these explicit LiveKit invariant detectors fail before a historical fix and pass now.
findings.impact: These invariant branches lack executable counterexamples and can silently become dead or be removed without a focused regression failing.
findings.requiredResolution: Add historical variants and minimized fixtures for reconnect duplication and platform evidence crossing while retaining separate Android/iOS higher-tier evidence.

findings.evidence: This isolated review lane ran focused checks only and did not start, monitor, or wait on full CI.
findings.requiredResolution: The coordinator must own one complete Phase 1 CI execution at exact implementation head 01ad30e4e0143cc4586b6d1be93c650ed753fd38 after review freeze.
